meta_description:
1,393 likes, 218 comments - ramit on October 12, 2026: "Your dog does not deserve $1,029 a month in food, treats, and toys.

Not when your fixed costs are at 154% of your take-home pay. They’re lovely dogs, and they’ll be fine. But this is what happens when you never look at the actual numbers. Spending that feels normal quietly adds up to something you’d never agree to if you saw it all at once.

Comment AUDIT and I’ll send you my free Spending Audit Guide so you can find out where your money is actually going (and which line items need a very strict diet).

▶️ Watch and listen to “Money For Couples” on Spotify, YouTube, or wherever you get your podcasts.".
